environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in a private subnet (10.0.48.0/20) within a VPC that has NO NAT Gateway, NO NAT Instance, and NO VPC endpoints other than the EFS mount target. The subnet route table (rtb-0a3f7c9e2d) contains only the local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. Security group sg-0b8e4f2a1c allows inbound only from the internal ALB (sg-0d7a3e9f5b) on port 8080. The EFS mount (fs-0c4d8e2f6a) has a resource policy restricting access to the task role ARN only, and the EFS access point enforces POSIX UID 1000 with root directory /workspace/uploads and a creation mode of 0644 (no execute bit). There is no shared Lambda consumer on this EFS filesystem - the processing pipeline reads from a separate SQS queue that is not connected to this service's upload path.

config.network: private subnet 10.0.48.0/20, route table rtb-0a3f7c9e2d with ONLY local route 10.0.0.0/16
config.nat: NONE - no NAT gateway, no NAT instance
config.vpc_endpoints: only com.amazonaws.us-east-1.elasticfilesystem (interface endpoint for EFS mount)
config.security_group: sg-0b8e4f2a1c ingress only from sg-0d7a3e9f5b (ALB) on 8080, egress to EFS mount target SG only on 2049
config.efs_access_point: POSIX UID 1000, root /workspace/uploads, creation info mode 0644
config.efs_resource_policy: Condition: aws:PrincipalArn equals task role only
config.processing_pipeline: NOT connected - Lambda reads from SQS queue fed by separate ingestion service
config.egress_validation: VPC Flow Logs confirm zero accepted packets to destinations outside 10.0.0.0/16
